That is what makes us heathenistic. So the servants of Colossians 3:22 are Israel, and the enemy calling Judah heathen is only what the Lord already said Moab and Seir would say.

note.label: Joshua 7: The Accursed Thing and the Sin of Achan

precepts.why:
“Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen”. Achan was of Judah, and he was stoned and burned in the valley of Achor like the accursed thing he took. When Israel will not obey his voice, the Lord likens the house of Judah unto all the heathen.

Consider the contrast that closes these chapters: Achan the Israelite of Judah lacked faith and was put to death, while Rahab the Canaanite harlot was saved alive for her faith. Disobedience makes the Lord treat Israel like the heathen, so we must have the fear of the Lord in our hearts.

note.label: Joshua 11: The Northern Kings Utterly Destroyed

precepts.why:
“Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them”. Edom revenged himself upon Judah over and above his charge. “Therefore thus saith the Lord God; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.”

“And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord God.” Israel will lay the vengeance of the Most High upon Edom according to his anger and according to his fury, by the hand of his people, as Joshua took all those kings and slew them. Brothers, you just have to endure to the end.

note.label: Psalm 58: The Righteous Shall Rejoice When He Seeth the Vengeance

precepts.why:
“And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord God.” The Most High is going to lay his vengeance upon Edom by the hand of his people Israel, his battle axe. Israel does in Edom according to his anger and his fury, and Edom shall know his vengeance.

That is how the righteous wash their feet in the blood of the wicked: the vengeance is the Most High's, and it comes by Israel's hand. Then a man shall say, verily there is a reward for the righteous, and a God that judgeth in the earth. That is a beautiful thing.

note.label: Ezekiel 25: Judgment on Ammon, Moab, Edom, and the Philistines

precepts.why:
“And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel”. Zechariah shows the hand: “When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.”

The Most High bends Judah as His bow and fills it with Ephraim as the arrows, and raises up the sons of Zion against the sons of Greece, the sons of the white man. Edom, the so-called white man, dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance and greatly offended, and Israel shall do in Edom “according to mine anger and according to my fury”.

This is future prophecy that has not yet come to pass. The Most High must first change our minds to act according to His anger, so that we perform righteous recompense with our own hands, as the sword of a mighty man in His hand.

This is the vengeance laid upon Edom by the hand of His people Israel. Jacob is the fire and Joseph the flame; the house of Esau is the stubble, the victim, consumed until none remains. Because Edom greatly offended against the house of Judah, Israel shall do in Edom according to His anger and His fury, and Edom shall know His vengeance. The Lord has spoken it.
